newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 3.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 3.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
A light cold front in the Gulf of Mexico is expected to draw clouds toward the coasts of Tamaulipas and northern Veracruz states.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Possible scattered rains as cold front lands on northern Sonora and Chihuahua states. Winds generally from north and northwest at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour), and slightly higher in Sinaloa and Sonora states.
Weak cold front heading southwest expected to hit the northern gulf later in the day. Clear skies along the shores, with maximum wind speeds off 10 to 15 knots.
Slightly cloudy with possible showers. Moderate winds from the east at 20 to 30 km per hour.
